description: Updates up to 200 contacts in one call (People API people:batchUpdateContacts). Each entry names a contact (resource_name, optional etag — missing etags are auto-fetched in ONE extra batchGet read) plus the same normalized fields as update_contact. CAUTION — the API applies ONE shared update mask to the whole batch, computed here as the union of every entry's provided field groups: a group that one entry provides and another omits is CLEARED on the omitting entry. Safest is to give every entry the same set of fields; each provided group replaces its stored group as a whole, exactly like update_contact. Atomic per request; a stale etag fails the whole batch with 400 — re-read and retry deliberately, never blindly.

read_mask.description: Person fields to return (default names, emailAddresses, phoneNumbers, organizations, memberships). Only masked fields come back — an absent field may be unmasked, not empty.

updates.description: The updates (1..200) — give every entry the same set of contact fields (shared mask).

addresses.description: Postal addresses. On update this list replaces ALL existing addresses; [] clears them.

birthday.description: Birthday: "YYYY-MM-DD", or "MM-DD" for a year-less birthday. On update "" clears it.

emails.description: Email addresses. On update this list replaces ALL existing emails; [] clears them.

etag.description: The contact's current etag — omit to auto-fetch.

notes.description: Free-text notes (the "Notes" field in Google Contacts). On update "" clears it.

organization.description: Employer info. On update it replaces the existing organizations; {} clears them.

phones.description: Phone numbers. On update this list replaces ALL existing phones; [] clears them.

resource_name.description: The contact's full resource name, e.g. "people/c1234567890" — exactly as returned by list_contacts, search_contacts or create_contact.

urls.description: Websites. On update this list replaces ALL existing urls; [] clears them.

name: batch_update_contacts
title: Update many contacts at once
